value.text: Arconati: acquired 1632, given 1637, withdrawn in exchange

claims.statement: Galeazzo Arconati acquired the codex in 1632, included it in the 1637 donation to the Ambrosiana, and took it back in exchange for another Leonardo manuscript.

sources.cite: Archivio Storico Civico e Biblioteca Trivulziana on Google Arts and Culture, The notebook of Leonardo da Vinci.

value.text: Bought by Don Carlo Trivulzio around 1750

claims.statement: Don Carlo Trivulzio (1715 to 1789) bought the manuscript around 1750; the Trivulzio collection entered the Milan civic collections in 1935.

sources.cite: Archivio Storico Civico e Biblioteca Trivulziana on Google Arts and Culture, The notebook of Leonardo da Vinci.
